intro: Obsidian the Elder is an encounter with an ancestral spirit during the Lunar Festival. Situated in Silverpine Forest near the Sepulcher, he honors travelers who come to pay homage to the ancient traditions of Azeroth. Visiting him provides a Coin of Ancestry and his blessing.

clips.title: Completion
paras: It is good to know the people of this land still pay homage to the olden races. I bid you well, friend, and offer you this token...
